in_sanskrit.name: Phoolchand
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Flowers
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Phoolchand एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Phoolchand means 'Lord of Flowers'. This beautiful and evocative name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'phool' meaning flower and 'chand' meaning lord.

in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has the moon as his crest or symbol (Phool represents the moon in Hindu symbolism)
